subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir has killed an ettin with his hands and dragged the Pudding King through his own throne room, and now focuses on tying knots for Daz while accepting the practical realities of their mission.
source_quote: I have killed an ettin with my hands. I dragged the Pudding King through his own throne room.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin has acquired facility with thrown weapons — a Sharpshooter's instinct — and advocates for javelins to hold the gap in the next engagement, finding humor in the name 'Ember Grapple'.
source_quote: Thorin mentioned javelins. He had apparently acquired some facility with thrown weapons — a Sharpshooter's instinct, trained in, applied to range.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum made a sound and may have found the name 'Ember Grapple' funny, alongside Thorin, though it is unclear who exactly reacted.
source_quote: Grygum made a sound. Thorin said something about 'the Ember Grapple.' Someone — possibly Thorin again, possibly Grygum, it is hard to tell when they are both making noise — found this very funny.

subject: Ember Vanguard
fact: The Ember Vanguard charges in with fire and flash, announcing itself — possibly the same entity as the Ember Grapple, described from a different perspective.
source_quote: The Ember Vanguard charges in with fire and flash and the announcement of itself.

subject: Ember Grapple
fact: The Ember Grapple holds something still until there is nothing left to hold — possibly the same entity as the Ember Vanguard, described from a different position in the room.
source_quote: The Ember Grapple holds something still until there is nothing left to hold.

subject: javelins
fact: Javelins have been acquired by Thorin and are intended for use in the next engagement to hold the gap, valued for their reach and practicality.
source_quote: Thorin mentioned javelins. He wanted something with reach for the next engagement.

subject: tunnels
fact: Zalthir has mentally retraced the tunnels they traveled, noting the distance, pace, and absence of immediate threats ahead.
source_quote: I turned that over the way I turn most things over: once, completely, and then I put it down. The math was the math. What we had was what we had.

subject: no long rest
fact: No long rest will occur before the next engagement, as resources are not replenished by wish or expectation.
source_quote: There would be no long rest before whatever came next. Nothing replenished itself on account of wishing.

subject: Ember Grapple identity
fact: The identity of the Ember Grapple versus the Ember Vanguard remains ambiguous — possibly two descriptions of the same faction from differing perspectives.
source_quote: Both accurate. Possibly the same party described from two different positions in the room.
